description: This file is a C header file defining interfaces and structures for managing sparse files, including functions for creating, destroying, adding data, reading, writing, and importing sparse files. It primarily provides an API for handling sparse file manipulation in C.

methods.name: sparse_file_new
methods.description: Creates a new sparse_file cookie with specified block size and total length.

methods.name: sparse_file_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a sparse_file cookie and frees associated resources.

methods.name: sparse_file_add_data
methods.description: Associates a data block with the sparse file at specified block offset.

methods.name: sparse_file_add_fill
methods.description: Associates a fill value for a region in the sparse file.

methods.name: sparse_file_add_file
methods.description: Associates a file chunk with the sparse file.

methods.name: sparse_file_add_fd
methods.description: Associates a file descriptor chunk with the sparse file.

methods.name: sparse_file_write
methods.description: Writes the sparse file to an output file descriptor with options for compression, sparse format, and CRC.

methods.name: sparse_file_len
methods.description: Returns the size of the sparse file if written to disk, in specified format.

methods.name: sparse_file_block_size
methods.description: Returns the block size used in the sparse file.

methods.name: sparse_file_callback
methods.description: Calls a callback function for each block in the sparse file, based on specified format and CRC options.

methods.name: sparse_file_foreach_chunk
methods.description: Calls a callback for each data block in the sparse file.

methods.name: sparse_file_read
methods.description: Reads data from a file descriptor into a sparse file object, supporting various read modes.

methods.name: sparse_file_import
methods.description: Imports a sparse file from a file descriptor, reconstructing the sparse cookie.

methods.name: sparse_file_import_buf
methods.description: Imports a sparse file from a buffer.

methods.name: sparse_file_import_auto
methods.description: Detects and imports either a sparse or normal file into a sparse file object.

methods.name: sparse_file_resparse
methods.description: Splits chunks of an existing sparse file into smaller files, respecting max length.

methods.name: sparse_file_verbose
methods.description: Enables verbose error printing for a sparse file.

methods.name: sparse_print_verbose
methods.description: Function pointer to print verbose errors; can be overridden.
